plan.title: Withdraw prepared eRFX project with live RFQ bids

steps.note: Open the existing prepared Tech+RFQ project with its live RFQ bid.
Enable eRFX multi-stage projects as required by the case.
Ensure the Withdraw Project action is offered.
Withdraw the complete project through the project menu; the step enters the withdrawal remark and confirms.
Assert that the project is recorded as withdrawn.
Open the RFQ stage to verify its withdrawn state.
Assert that the RFQ stage shows Withdrawn.
Open the Technical/RFP stage to verify its withdrawn state.
Assert that the Technical stage shows Withdrawn.
Inspect the invited QA vendor's supplier-portal view after project withdrawal.
Open the withdrawn event's Technical stage in the vendor portal.
Assert that the vendor sees the Technical stage as withdrawn.
Open the withdrawn event's RFQ pricing stage in the vendor portal.
Assert that the vendor sees the RFQ stage as withdrawn.
